Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's CEO, 11 days after he resigned.

Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate him as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately. Shares jumped more than 25% on the news. Interim CEO Colette Kress returns to her role as CFO.

The twist: days earlier the board had rejected his offer to return (AP). Now it says input from senior US government officials left it confident his return poses no national security risk.

This is news, not investment advice.

Sources: Nvidia (SEC filing), CNBC, AP, Tom's Hardware, Quartz.
